description: Read one Celestia community forum thread (forum.celestia.org) with its posts, by topic id. This is the CELESTIA FORUM channel — not GitHub Discussions (use get_github_discussion). The topic id is the number at the end of the thread link that search, get_recent_changes and the list tools print (https://blobpedia.org/discussions/2314 is topic 2314); that link is accepted as well.

id.description: Forum topic number, e.g. 2314, or the thread link https://blobpedia.org/discussions/2314

name: get_discussion
